about: Every user-facing feature entrance, with the classic interface (/) as the baseline (owner, 2026-10-23, M203).
classic: selectors in frontend/index.html; each must still exist. Every <button id> there belongs to a feature or to not_entrances.
vopus / next: where the same feature is entered in /vopus/ and /next/, or 'missing' with what is not ported yet.
Never delete a feature or a selector to make a check pass. A removal the owner agreed to goes to 'removed' with date, reason and the owner's words.
Checks: backend/tests/test_feature_entrances.py (fast, static) and tests/e2e/specs/feature-entrances.spec.ts (real browser).
